visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) High-angle overview of Shen Ji New Village with rows of white market umbrellas and a yellow historic building on the left. A woman in a blue skirt walks through the central brick path. (2) Close-ups of market activity: a hand pointing at a jewelry stall, crowds walking under the umbrellas, and a view of the street bustling with visitors. (3) Food close-up: a Two Day Soufflé Pancake topped with cream and syrup sits on a tray. A vendor pours a light-colored beverage from a plastic bottle into a paper cup at a Rinkings stall. (4) Close-up of wing-shaped earrings in a package. A duo of street performers, a male with a guitar and a female singer, perform in front of a building. (5) A black cat wearing a leash and a small white hat walks on a green artificial turf area scattered with dried leaves. (6) Interior of the National Taichung Theater featuring a curved white wall with illuminated circular cutouts and a red carpet. The camera pans to a modern glass elevator and people in the background. (7) Rooftop view of the theater showing white tent-like structures, manicured green lawns, and pink benches against a backdrop of urban high-rises. (8) Exterior of the modern theater building with glass walls and large promotional posters. (9) At Lalaport Taichung, the main female creator pops her head out of a large furry Totoro Catbus display. She then stands inside the Catbus with arms wide open, smiling. (10) Interior of a colorful children's play area with soft green and blue mats, wooden arches, and small tables. A child is seen playing on the floor. (11) Display shelves filled with Studio Ghibli merchandise, followed by close-ups of Calcifer, Kiki, and Totoro figurines. (12) Wide shot of the modern Taichung Train Station steel structure with a yellow caterpillar sculpture hanging. A shot of the old red-brick station building follows. (13) Interior of a renovated old train carriage functioning as a shop with yellow walls and black cat paw prints on the floor. People browse the items. (14) Exterior shot of a yellow train carriage on old tracks, used as an information and retail space.

It aims to encourage tourism by showcasing diverse activities like shopping at creative markets, visiting architectural landmarks, exploring themed malls, and experiencing historical station renovations.
